positions.title: Senior Data Analyst
positions.description: Engineered 12+ ETL pipelines using AWS Redshift and S3 to streamline healthcare data transfers for customer and vendor reporting, reducing data error rates by 25% and improving processing speed by 40%. Partnered with cross-functional product and engineering teams to build analytics and reporting infrastructure, enabling rapid identification of key metric trends and driving a 15% increase in feature adoption within six months. Developed 8 interactive Power BI and Looker dashboards for customer-facing and internal use, enabling real-time KPI tracking and reducing manual reporting time by 50%. Authored documentation for reporting specs, data flows, and infrastructure changes, increasing dashboard adoption and cutting ad-hoc data requests by 30+ per quarter. Mentored 5+ team members in advanced AWS and Tableau techniques, reducing dependency on external resources for data analysis by 30% and strengthening team's data capabilities.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Optimized 50+ SQL queries and automated recurring ETL jobs supporting campaign reporting, reducing system latency by 35% and saving 30+ engineering hours per month. Built Tableau dashboards to track operational KPIs, campaign performance, and audience segments, enabling data-driven marketing optimizations that boosted ROI by 18%. Conducted in-depth product analytics on driver and rider engagement trends, surfacing behavioral insights that guided feature enhancements and improved user satisfaction scores by 12%. Collaborated with marketing and external partners to refine data exchange processes and reconcile reporting discrepancies, improving data quality and reporting accuracy across both organizations.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Leveraged Python, SQL, and AWS (S3, Redshift) to analyze large-scale clinical datasets in compliance with regulatory requirements, improving research accuracy by 20% and enabling faster decisions across 3 departments. Designed and deployed 10+ Power BI dashboards providing executives with real-time business insights and performance reporting, reducing decision-making cycle time by 35 hours per month. Streamlined scalable ETL workflows and dimensional data models with integrated data validation rules, enabling 60+ business users to access timely and accurate data and boosting operational efficiency. Spearheaded development of a patient tracking system that eliminated 30,000+ annual data entry errors and reduced report generation time by 45 minutes per report.
